chunks.ar: عمل خادم في بيت رجل غني، وكان يعرف كل غرفة وكل باب فيه.
chunks.en_old: A servant worked in a wealthy man’s house and knew every room and every door.
chunks.en_new: A servant worked in a wealthy man’s house and knew every room and every door.

chunks.ar: لكنه اتفق مع صديق له على السرقة.
chunks.en_old: But he made a plan to steal with a friend.
chunks.en_new: But he made a plan to steal with a friend.

chunks.ar: كان الصديق يدخل البيت عندما يخرج أصحابه،
chunks.en_old: His friend came inside whenever the owners went out,
chunks.en_new: His friend came inside whenever the owners went out,

chunks.ar: ثم يبيعان ما يأخذانه ويقسمان المال.
chunks.en_old: and they sold what they took and divided the money.
chunks.en_new: and they sold what they took and divided the money.

chunks.ar: وفي ليلة، خرج أهل البيت لزيارة أقاربهم.
chunks.en_old: One night, the family went out to visit relatives.
chunks.en_new: One night, the family went out to visit relatives.

chunks.ar: جاء الصديق، وبدأ الاثنان يجمعان أشياء ثمينة في أكياس.
chunks.en_old: The friend arrived, and the two began putting valuable things into bags.
chunks.en_new: The friend arrived, and the two began putting valuable things into bags.

chunks.ar: كانا يظنان أن أمامهما وقتًا طويلًا، وأن أحدًا لن يعود قريبًا.
chunks.en_old: They thought they had plenty of time and that nobody would return soon.
chunks.en_new: They thought they had plenty of time and that nobody would return soon.

chunks.ar: فجأة، سمعا طرقًا قويًا على الباب الأمامي.
chunks.en_old: Suddenly, they heard loud knocking at the front door.
chunks.en_new: Suddenly, they heard loud knocking at the front door.

chunks.ar: صاح صاحب البيت من الخارج: «افتحوا الباب!»
chunks.en_old: The owner shouted from outside, “Open the door!”
chunks.en_new: The owner shouted from outside, “Open the door!”

chunks.ar: خاف الرجلان. قال الخادم لصديقه:
chunks.en_old: Both men were terrified. The servant told his friend,
chunks.en_new: Both men were terrified. The servant told his friend,

chunks.ar: «اهرب بسرعة من الباب الخلفي، عند البئر!» وأشار إليه بيده.
chunks.en_old: “Quick! Escape through the back door by the well!” and pointed the way.
chunks.en_new: “Quick! Escape through the back door by the well!” and pointed the way.

chunks.ar: ركض اللص إلى الخلف، ووجد الباب المفتوح.
chunks.en_old: The thief ran to the back and found the open door.
chunks.en_new: The thief ran to the back and found the open door.

chunks.ar: لكنه لم يرَ بئرًا بجانبه.
chunks.en_old: But he saw no well beside it.
chunks.en_new: But he saw no well beside it.

chunks.ar: عاد مسرعًا إلى الخادم وقال:
chunks.en_old: He hurried back to the servant and said,
chunks.en_new: He hurried back to the servant and said,

chunks.ar: «وجدت الباب، لكن أين البئر التي تحدثت عنها؟»
chunks.en_old: “I found the door, but where is the well you mentioned?”
chunks.en_new: “I found the door, but where is the well you mentioned?”

chunks.ar: قال الخادم: «لم أذكر البئر إلا لتعرف مكان الباب!
chunks.en_old: “I mentioned the well only to help you find the door!” the servant said.
chunks.en_new: “I mentioned the well only to help you find the door!” the servant said.

chunks.ar: إذا وجدته، فاخرج فورًا!»
chunks.en_old: “Once you find it, go out immediately!”
chunks.en_new: “Once you find it, go out immediately!”

chunks.ar: رد اللص: «ولكنك قلت إن البئر هناك.
chunks.en_old: The thief replied, “But you said the well was there.
chunks.en_new: The thief replied, “But you said the well was there.

chunks.ar: بحثت عنها ولم أجدها. كيف أخرج دون أن أراها؟»
chunks.en_old: I looked and could not find it. How can I leave without seeing it?”
chunks.en_new: I looked and could not find it. How can I leave without seeing it?”

chunks.ar: ازدادت أصوات الطرق على الباب، وبدأ صاحب البيت يغضب.
chunks.en_old: The knocking grew louder, and the owner became angry.
chunks.en_new: The knocking grew louder, and the owner became angry.

chunks.ar: توسل الخادم إلى صديقه: «انسَ البئر!
chunks.en_old: The servant begged his friend, “Forget the well!
chunks.en_new: The servant begged his friend, “Forget the well!

chunks.ar: الباب أمامك، والنجاة قريبة!»
chunks.en_old: The door is in front of you, and you can still escape!”
chunks.en_new: The door is in front of you, and you can still escape!”

chunks.ar: لكن اللص ظل يسأل عن البئر المفقودة.
chunks.en_old: But the thief kept asking about the missing well.
chunks.en_new: But the thief kept asking about the missing well.

chunks.ar: وأخيرًا، فُتح الباب الأمامي، ودخل صاحب البيت.
chunks.en_old: At last, the front door opened, and the owner came inside.
chunks.en_new: At last, the front door opened, and the owner came inside.

chunks.ar: رأى الأكياس المملوءة بأشيائه، ثم رأى الرجلين يتجادلان.
chunks.en_old: He saw bags filled with his belongings and then the two men arguing.
chunks.en_new: He saw bags filled with his belongings and then the two men arguing.

chunks.ar: حاول اللص أن يهرب، لكن الوقت كان قد فات،
chunks.en_old: The thief tried to run, but it was too late,
chunks.en_new: The thief tried to run, but it was too late,

chunks.ar: فأمسك به صاحب البيت.
chunks.en_old: and the owner caught him.
chunks.en_new: and the owner caught him.

chunks.ar: سأل صاحب البيت: «لماذا لم تهرب من الباب الخلفي؟»
chunks.en_old: “Why did you not escape through the back door?” the owner asked.
chunks.en_new: “Why did you not escape through the back door?” the owner asked.

chunks.ar: قال اللص في حيرة: «وجدت الباب، لكنني لم أجد البئر!»
chunks.en_old: The thief answered, confused, “I found the door, but I could not find the well!”
chunks.en_new: The thief answered, confused, “I found the door, but I could not find the well!”

chunks.ar: لم يصدق الرجل ما سمعه.
chunks.en_old: The owner could hardly believe it.
chunks.en_new: The man could not believe what he heard.

chunks.ar: وأخذ اللص إلى الحاكم، وبقيت الأكياس في البيت.
chunks.en_old: He took the thief to the judge, and the bags stayed in the house.
chunks.en_new: He took the thief to the governor, and the bags stayed in the house.
